description: This file defines the EmployeePictureAPI class which provides RESTful API endpoints for retrieving and updating employee picture data within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods for getting an employee's picture, updating it, and setting validation rules, integrating with services and models related to employee images.

classes.name: EmployeePictureAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing access to employee picture data, including retrieve and update functionalities, within the HRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves an employee's picture based on employee number.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or creates an employee's picture with the data provided in the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring the employee number is accessible.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating the employee picture, including validation of the attachment.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Unsupported operation; method throws an exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Unsupported operation; method throws an exception.
